title: Lovely Juicy Thai Farfalle Noodles
description: Savory and juicy Thai dish featuring farfalle noodles and agemono deep fry technique, inspired by Isaan cuisine, this dish brings back nostalgic memories of street food in Thailand.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the farfalle noodles according to the package instructions until al dente.
While the noodles are cooking, heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the hot oil and deep fry until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the fried onion and bell pepper from the oil and set them aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same oil, add the mushrooms and deep fry until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the mushrooms from the oil and set them aside with the onion and bell pepper.
In a large pan, heat a couple of tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium heat and add the Thai red curry paste.
Cook the curry paste for about 1 minute, stirring constantly, until it is fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and salt to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked noodles, fried onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the sauce and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
